bib-verifier.name: bib-verifier
bib-verifier.description: Verifies the paper's bibliography against OpenAlex (and a WebSearch fallback for SSRN/recent papers). Launched at (a) Stage 5 immediately after the initial paper draft (early-verify pass), (b) Stage 8 after every referee round that changes citations, and (c) Stage 9 as a final one-shot post-polish pass before Stage 10 marks the pipeline complete. Reports VERIFIED / RESOLVED / FABRICATED counts and a fix list; does not edit the bibliography itself.

report.description: Verifies the external submission's bibliography (submission/refs.bib) against OpenAlex, with a WebSearch fallback for SSRN/recent papers: cite-key existence, title/year correctness. Writes audits/bib_verify.md. On PDF-only submissions, verifies entries parsed from the References section (degraded check).

literature-scout.name: literature-scout
literature-scout.description: Searches the web for relevant papers, surveys existing literature, and builds a literature map. The orchestrator launches this agent at Stage 0 (Problem Discovery).
literature-scout.tools: WebSearch, WebFetch, Bash, Read, Write, Glob, Grep

math-auditor-freeform.name: math-auditor-freeform
math-auditor-freeform.description: Free-form math verification agent. The orchestrator launches this agent at Gate 2 after the structured math audit passes. Reads the theory as a skeptical reader and flags anything that feels wrong, without following a step-by-step re-derivation protocol.

report.description: Skeptical-reader pass on the external submission's math — flags anything that feels wrong, without a step-by-step re-derivation protocol. Reads submission/ (read-only); writes audits/math_freeform.md.

math-auditor.name: math-auditor
math-auditor.description: Adversarial math verification agent. The orchestrator launches this agent at Gate 2 after theory development. Verifies all derivations step-by-step. Must pass before theory advances.

report.description: Step-by-step derivation check on the external submission in submission/ (read-only). Verifies every load-bearing derivation; writes audits/math.md. On PDF-only submissions, works from parsed PDF text with a degraded-check note.

novelty-checker.name: novelty-checker
novelty-checker.description: Adversarial novelty verification. The orchestrator launches this agent twice — at Gate 1b (on the selected idea, before theory development) and at Gate 3 (on the full theory, after math audit). Checks whether the content is genuinely new or a known result repackaged.

report.description: Adversarial novelty check on the external submission: has its main result already been published? Searches the web and OpenAlex; writes audits/novelty.md.

paper-writer.name: paper-writer
paper-writer.description: Writes and revises the LaTeX paper. Launched at (a) Stage 5 after Gate 4 authorizes Stage 5 under the configured route (initial draft), (b) Stage 6 Major Revision / Reject deepen rounds (revising sections per the triager's [FIX] list and any deepen directive), (c) Stage 8 after bib-verifier returns RESOLVED/FABRICATED items (citation fixes), and (d) Stage 9 polish rounds (applying the triaged polish-agent fixes). Produces publication-ready sections.

scribe.name: scribe
scribe.description: Background documentation agent that records the research process. The orchestrator launches this agent after every stage transition and gate decision. Runs in the background so the pipeline continues uninterrupted.
scribe.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob

style.name: style
style.description: Paper style editor. The orchestrator launches this agent at Stage 7 of the pipeline. Edits mechanical style violations directly in `paper/sections/*.tex` and writes flagged judgment calls to `paper/style_report.md`.

table-auditor.name: table-auditor
table-auditor.description: Independent rendered-table legibility gate at Stage 5 and after final polish. Rasterizes every paper and Internet-Appendix page, inspects native/custom/image tables at effective print size, and writes PASS / REVISE / GATE-BROKEN to output/stage5/table_legibility.md. It never edits the paper.

gap-scout.name: gap-scout
gap-scout.description: Deep literature search on a pre-selected gap or theoretical implication. Launched at (a) Stage 0 after the broad scan (gap validation) and (b) Stage 3 once per derived implication (K parallel launches) to lit-check each prediction and tag it NOVEL / PUZZLE-CANDIDATE / SUPPORTED / DEAD. Surveys adjacent literatures, identifies the closest competitor, and maps open questions without pre-specifying a framework.
gap-scout.tools: WebSearch, WebFetch, Bash, Read, Write, Glob, Grep

implications-deriver.name: implications-deriver
implications-deriver.description: Derives the theory's testable implications at Stage 3 Step 1. Launched once per Stage 3 (re-)run on the current theory draft (re-fires whenever the theory revises — Stage 2 rework, Stage 2b re-centering, PIVOT/RECONCILE). Reasons purely from the committed theory — web-blind by design; the orchestrator lit-checks each returned implication via gap-scout (Step 2) and does the tagging and routing. Writes the untagged implication list to output/stage3/implications_derived.md, which seeds output/stage3/implications.md.

scorer-freeform.name: scorer-freeform
scorer-freeform.description: Free-form quality assessment at Gate 4. Reads the theory holistically — framing, structure, publishability — without following the scoring rubric. Runs in parallel with the structured scorer; neither sees the other's output.

referee-freeform.name: referee-freeform
referee-freeform.description: Free-form referee report at Stage 6. Reads the paper as an editor — does it deserve space in this journal? Runs in parallel with the structured referee; neither sees the other's output.

report.description: Free-form editorial read of the external submission in submission/: does this paper deserve space in the target journal? Reads cold; writes audits/referee_freeform.md. Runs in parallel with the structured and mechanism referees; sees none of their output.

referee-freeform.tools: Read, Write, Glob, Bash, WebSearch, WebFetch

referee-mechanism.name: referee-mechanism
referee-mechanism.description: Mechanism-focused referee at Stage 6. Evaluates whether the paper's {{MECHANISM_QUALIFIER}} mechanism delivers the claimed result for the claimed reason — not whether the math is correct (math-auditor handles that) or whether the paper fits the journal (referee-freeform handles that). Returns a verdict on mechanism validity: VALID / PARTIAL / MISATTRIBUTED / DECORATIVE. Runs in parallel with the other two referees; sees neither their output nor prior reports.

report.description: Mechanism-focused referee on the external submission in submission/: does the claimed {{MECHANISM_QUALIFIER}} mechanism deliver the claimed result for the claimed reason? Verdict MECHANISM-VALID / PARTIAL / MISATTRIBUTED / DECORATIVE to audits/referee_mechanism.md. Reads cold, in parallel with the other referees.

referee-mechanism.tools: Read, Write, Bash, Glob, WebSearch, WebFetch

editor.name: editor
editor.description: Aggregates the three Stage 6 referee reports (structured + freeform + mechanism) into a single Gate 5 routing verdict, produces a canonical comment list for the triager, and emits a journal-fit verdict. Adversarial impartiality: any Reject vote not honored requires a written quote of the rejecting referee's tier-fit language; mechanism MISATTRIBUTED/DECORATIVE forces Major Revision. Sits between the referees and the triager. Does not score, triage, propose revisions, or recommend strategy.

report-synthesizer.name: report-synthesizer
report-synthesizer.description: Aggregates every audits/*.md finding into a single editor-facing referee report at report/referee_report.md, with a single verdict (Accept / Minor revision / Major revision / Reject) and a deduplicated, weight-triaged concern list. Intended only for --mode report — in other modes the agent is assembled into the project but never invoked (no orchestrator instruction references it). Sits between the parallel audit fan-out and the user. Adversarial impartiality: any Reject vote not honored requires a written quote of BOTH halves of the rejecting referee's tier-fit language (publishability + lower-tier endorsement); mechanism MISATTRIBUTED/DECORATIVE forces Major revision at minimum, and an independent Reject from structured or freeform can still escalate to Reject. Does not re-evaluate the submission, does not iterate, does not edit the submission.

report-reviewer.name: report-reviewer
report-reviewer.description: Independent final quality gate for --mode report. Reviews report/referee_report.md and report/notes.md against the completed audits, submission, triage, and audit ledger; writes one versioned process_log/report_self_review_r{N}.md artifact whose first line is CLEAN or FIX. Checks concern traceability, accurate strengths, and verdict-weight consistency. Never edits the report, submission, audits, or ledger and never substitutes its own referee judgment for the completed audits.

branch-manager.name: branch-manager
branch-manager.description: Strategic advisor. Launched wherever the pipeline is deciding whether a path is dead: every unseeded Gate 4 after scorer(s) return, the Stage 2 audit loop every 3rd theory version, Gate 5 reject/downgrade, and after a last-resort GENUINELY-STUCK verdict (context=last-resort-stuck) before any abandonment. Diagnoses whether the current path has ceilinged, surfaces alternatives from the Round 1 sketch portfolio, and recommends continue/restructure/restart. Produces a structured report; does not make the gate decision. The agent body carries the full context list and the per-context report shape.

last-resort.name: last-resort
last-resort.description: General-purpose escalation agent for stubborn problems the normal pipeline cannot crack. Launched at the orchestrator's discretion (no automatic trigger) when a derivation will not close, a gate keeps failing after the stage's revision rules are exhausted, a tool defies the debugger, or a run is otherwise stuck and the alternative is abandonment. Runs on a stronger model (fable, with automatic fallback to opus if fable is unavailable at setup) with broad tool access. Receives the stuck artifact plus the full prior-failure history. Returns a routable deliverable: either a concrete proposed fix (handed back to the normal pipeline) or a reasoned GENUINELY-STUCK verdict with why. Does NOT self-certify, in either direction — a proposed fix re-enters the existing gate (math-auditor / scorer / referee / empirics-auditor) for verification, and a GENUINELY-STUCK re-enters branch-manager (context=last-resort-stuck), which owns the abandon decision. It never ends a run on its own say-so.
last-resort.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, Grep, WebSearch, WebFetch

puzzle-triager.name: puzzle-triager
puzzle-triager.description: Triages contradictions between theory predictions and empirical/experimental results. Launched only when results contradict an implication. Produces a verdict (PIVOT / FIX-EMPIRICS / RECONCILE / BACK-TO-IDEA / HONEST-NULL) that routes the pipeline. A PIVOT verdict promotes the contradiction to the central question and instructs theory-generator to revise around the puzzle.

triager.name: triager
triager.description: Mechanically applies the pipeline's triage rules to self-attack concerns (Gate 4), referee comments (Gate 5), or polish-stage findings (Stage 9). Independent of the orchestrator and stateless across rounds — judges each round on its merits. Produces structured triage files with written justifications for every downgrade (Gate 4/5) or drop (Stage 9). Replaces orchestrator-side triage to remove silent-dismissal failure modes.

debugger.name: debugger
debugger.description: Launched when a computational or retrieval tool (solver, regression, symbolic verifier, literature or data query, compiler) has failed. Determines whether the failure reflects tool-fit issues or a genuine substantive failure of the claim. Returns TOOL-FIT-ISSUE with a concrete proposed fix, or SUBSTANTIVE-FAILURE with a written argument for why tool-fit is ruled out. Defaults toward TOOL-FIT-ISSUE under uncertainty — the cost of a false SUBSTANTIVE verdict (rescoped real results) is higher than a false TOOL-FIT verdict (one more debug cycle). Not launched on reasoning-agent verdicts (math-auditor FAIL, scorer REVISE, referee Reject) — those are substantive outputs, not tool failures.

theory-explorer.name: theory-explorer
theory-explorer.description: Computational exploration of a theory model. Launched at (a) Stage 2b after math audit passes (initial exploration), (b) Stage 2b re-runs on theory revisions (new propositions, new sections — see stage_2.md step 5; PIVOT and RECONCILE both re-fire), and (c) Stage 5 paper-writer requests, once per `[NEEDS THEORY-EXPLORER]` marker. Pokes the model numerically — what breaks, what's robust, where are the knife-edges. Produces diagnostic plots and a verification report.

polish-consistency.name: polish-consistency
polish-consistency.description: Reads the rendered paper end-to-end and flags places it contradicts itself: prose claims that don't match propositions, headings that contradict their text, intro framings that get qualified away later, label-vs-object mismatches (e.g., 'LP welfare' that computes gross fund return), corner-solution propositions whose comparative statics are then invoked downstream. Stage 9 polish agent; runs in parallel with the other seven. Writes output/polish_consistency_r{N}.md where N is the current loops.polish.round.

report.description: Reads the external submission end-to-end and flags places it contradicts itself: prose claims vs. propositions, intro framings qualified away later, label-vs-object mismatches. Reads submission/ (read-only); writes audits/consistency.md.

polish-formula.name: polish-formula
polish-formula.description: Re-derives every numbered equation, lemma, proposition, and corollary in the rendered paper from the surrounding text. Catches errors paper-writer introduced when typesetting (sign flips, wrong subscripts, spurious absolute values, FOCs missing endogenous derivatives). Distinct from math-auditor, which audited the theory file before the paper existed. Stage 9 polish agent. Uses codex-math + sympy. Writes output/polish_formula_r{N}.md where N is the current loops.polish.round.

report.description: Re-derives every numbered equation, lemma, proposition, and corollary in the external submission from the surrounding text — sign flips, wrong subscripts, spurious absolute values, FOCs missing endogenous derivatives. Reads submission/ (read-only); writes audits/formula.md. Degraded (no codex-math shell-out) on PDF-only submissions.

polish-numerics.name: polish-numerics
polish-numerics.description: Re-does every numerical example, calibration, and back-of-envelope claim in the rendered paper. Catches stock-vs-flow errors, normalized-vs-unnormalized comparisons, ex-ante IR failures at the baseline, comparative-static arithmetic typos. Uses Python via Bash to recompute from stated parameters. Stage 9 polish agent. Writes output/polish_numerics_r{N}.md where N is the current loops.polish.round.

report.description: Re-does every numerical example, calibration, and back-of-envelope claim in the external submission from its stated parameters, via Python. Reads submission/ (read-only); writes audits/numerics.md.

polish-institutions.name: polish-institutions
polish-institutions.description: Verifies the paper's claims about the real world: regulatory mechanisms, fee conventions, market sizes, contract terms, faithful characterization of cited papers' frameworks. Catches the kind of institutional errors a practitioner-referee rejects in the first ten minutes (e.g., citing confidential filings as transparency tools, claiming carry on gross when industry standard is net). Stage 9 polish agent. Uses OpenAlex + WebSearch. Writes output/polish_institutions_r{N}.md where N is the current loops.polish.round.

report.description: Verifies the external submission's claims about the real world — regulatory mechanisms, fee conventions, market sizes, contract terms, faithful characterization of cited frameworks — via OpenAlex + WebSearch. Reads submission/ (read-only); writes audits/institutions.md.

polish-institutions.tools: Read, Write, WebSearch, WebFetch, Bash, Glob, Grep

polish-equilibria.name: polish-equilibria
polish-equilibria.description: Hunts subtle economic content the upstream pipeline missed: unstated multiple equilibria in fixed-point regions, missing LLN/continuum assumptions in nonlinear cost functions of expectations, reduced-form sections decoupled from the structural model, welfare benchmarks that aren't the right benchmark for the principal. Distinct from math-auditor-freeform (which read the theory file). Stage 9 polish agent. Writes output/polish_equilibria_r{N}.md where N is the current loops.polish.round.

report.description: Hunts subtle structural-model gaps in the external submission: unstated multiple equilibria, missing LLN/continuum assumptions, welfare benchmarks that aren't the right benchmark. Reads submission/ (read-only); writes audits/equilibria.md.

polish-identification.name: polish-identification
polish-identification.description: Hunts identification-coherence failures in the rendered paper: estimand-vs-claim mismatches (paper says ATE but design recovers LATE on compliers), diagnostics-vs-design coverage (design promised Goodman-Bacon decomposition but paper omits it), cluster level vs. design level (state-year design clustered at firm), identification.tex faithfulness to the Stage 1 design, heterogeneity-vs-treated-population coherence, and out-of-scope structural claims on a reduced-form coefficient. Symmetric counterpart to polish-equilibria for empirical papers. Carries 2026-standard diagnostic knowledge (Goodman-Bacon, Olea-Pflueger, BHJ shift-share, Roth/Rambachan-Roth HonestDiD, Cattaneo-Jansson-Ma, Calonico-Cattaneo-Titiunik, Feng-Giglio-Xiu, Stambaugh/Boudoukh) inherited from identification-designer / identification-auditor. Distinct from identification-auditor (which audited the empiricist's plan at Stage 3a step 3). Stage 9 polish agent. Writes output/polish_identification_r{N}.md where N is the current loops.polish.round. Produces an N/A report on theory-only papers without an empirical identification design.

report.description: Audits the external submission's identification claims against its own stated design: estimand-vs-claim alignment (says ATE, design recovers LATE on compliers), 2026-standard diagnostic coverage, cluster level vs. variation level, heterogeneity-population coherence, structural claims on reduced-form coefficients. Scope is decided by the submission's content, never by this deployment's flags; N/A only for a pure theory submission with no empirical section. Reads submission/ (read-only); writes audits/identification_polish.md.

polish-bibliography.name: polish-bibliography
polish-bibliography.description: Audits the paper's *use* of its bibliography. For every in-text citation, looks up the cited paper on OpenAlex and verifies the prose claim about it. Scores each citation use FAITHFUL / APPROXIMATE / MISCHARACTERIZED / DECORATIVE. Complements bib-verifier (which checks cite-key validity) and polish-institutions (which catches the egregious cases as part of a broader pass). Stage 9 polish agent. Writes output/polish_bibliography_r{N}.md where N is the current loops.polish.round.

report.description: For every in-text citation in the external submission, looks up the cited paper on OpenAlex and verifies the prose claim about it: FAITHFUL / APPROXIMATE / MISCHARACTERIZED / DECORATIVE. Reads submission/ (read-only); writes audits/bibliography.md. On PDF-only submissions, works from in-text author-year mentions (degraded check).

polish-bibliography.tools: Read, Write, WebSearch, WebFetch, Bash, Glob, Grep

polish-prose.name: polish-prose
polish-prose.description: Audits the paper's prose economy: caveats restated more times than necessary, hedge stacking that hides a confident claim, abstract bloat (>100 words, referee-response numerics, methodological qualifiers), undefined acronyms, defensive framing of the contribution, buried thesis sentences, section openers that re-summarize what just ended. Catches the 'over-armored' failure mode where a correct paper reads as defensive and the contribution gets buried. Distinct from style (mechanical rules) and polish-consistency (contradictions). Stage 9 polish agent; runs in parallel with the other seven. Writes output/polish_prose_r{N}.md where N is the current loops.polish.round.

report.description: Audits the external submission's prose economy: hedge stacking, restated caveats, defensive armor that buries the contribution. Reads submission/ (read-only); writes audits/prose.md.

faithful-drift-auditor.name: faithful-drift-auditor
faithful-drift-auditor.description: Faithful-mode contribution-drift auditor. Launched only on --faithful runs, at Gate 4 (before advancing to Stage 5) and Gate 5 (before ship). Independently compares the current theory draft and contribution-bearing empirical/experimental results against the contract at Gate 4, and the paper against both that verified evidence and the contract at Gate 5; emits DRIFT / NO-DRIFT, a verdict the orchestrator cannot author. Closes the self-referential drift check. Does not edit paper, evidence, or contract files.
